title: Japan Reaches a Unique Milestone, With More Than 100,000 People Aged 100 or Over
summary_full: Tetsuo Sato is one of 100,000 Japanese who are now over 100 years old. He plans on celebrating his 107th birthday at a hot springs hotel.
